messagingSessionId.title: Messaging Session ID
messagingSessionId.description: The Id of this conversation (MessagingSession). Bound from the context variable RoutableId; never ask the patient for it.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Optional: one of the patient's device serial numbers, for example Test8, to read only that device.

readingCount.title: Number of Readings
readingCount.description: How many of the latest readings per device, newest first. 5 if empty, at most 20.
